■ Direction
退いちまった = stepped down / retired

★ Request

■ Direction
栄華 = glory / prosperity

★ Request

■ Direction
SE: Door opening sound (before dialogue)

★ Request
Gold Ship runs out of frame

WOOOOO—!! Fish, fish, fish 'em all up!
Today's goal is a huge catch, huge catch, and one more huge catch for good measure!!

When I say "Marco," you say "Polo."
When I'm "Fujin," you're also "Fujin."

A Trainer's role is to draw out an Umamusume's
full potential through daily training.

Why can't you understand how much immersing yourself in nature
and sharpening your wild instincts helps in a race?!!
Alright then, time to dig in!

Welp, now that our bellies are full,
let's head over to the Golshi Farm and watch the carrots grow.

Next time, let's meet somewhere in the solar system!
Smell ya later!

Huh? Are you trying to say that catching fish and eating 'em
isn't training?

Could it be that she's run out of patience from boredom
and is finally going to start training...?!

So, you wanna do training today no matter what.
Don't worry, message received loud and clear.

Hey, let's move, Trainer!
Start running toward Mars!

...Nothin's bitin'.
All I caught was the obligatory clump of seaweed.

Even my father, the number one fisherman in the village,
retired without ever catching the legendary guardian fish of this river...

That's why! As his daughter! I'll catch that guardian today for sure!
Ooooh, burn bright! My fisherman spirit—!!
Well, yeah, pretty much.

Huh? Are you trying to say that exploring an undersea temple
isn't training?

Hey, what are you just standing there staring for?!
You're helping too, got it?!

Phew~ that was a close one~.
I lost the fishing contest, but eating like this makes us even, right!

No need for unnecessary words between us at this point!
Alright, let's do this! Keep up with me!

...Uwoooooh!! Waaaahhh!!
No way, I'm gonna collapse from boredom at this rate!!

A symbol of ancient glory, now resting beneath the waves!
You're saying that the noble act of uncovering its mysteries isn't training?!

Living a self-sufficient survival lifestyle
is an extreme battle where danger lurks at every turn...

—They say "an Umamusume and her Trainer are in a three-legged race."
Supporting and encouraging each other through thick and thin to aim for victory.

Dragged along by her antics, we never got to do any training in the end,
and Gold Ship ended up sprinting away...

I need to do my best with top-notch training
to help Gold Ship seize victory...!

I never imagined the day would come when Gold Ship and I would be on the same page...!
Alright, let's head to the training track!

Come on now, when you come all the way to the water,
what else is there to do besides fish?
Nah, that has nothing to do with it though!

Ahhh, I'm stuffed.
Give thanks for all the food in the world.

The moment Gold Ship received the grilled fish set meal,
she devoured it in the blink of an eye...

—They say "an Umamusume and her Trainer are in a three-legged race."
Joining forces to aim for victory together... hopefully, surely!

Hey, Trainer!
Let's go explore an undersea temple right now!

Alright, to the training track... we... go...?
................Wait, what?

Hey lady!
One grilled fish set meal, extra rice, please!
Still unable to process what was going on, I cast my fishing line into the river for several dozen minutes—
